interpretation: Port bins use entirely interior query frames; the clock sensitivity trims at least 42 ms per edge. Chrony snapshots are a sensitivity input, not a bound on cross-host sync error. Short GET intervals may leave sparse or no port bins and MAC counters include any other port traffic. Absent bins do not imply idle. Device overlap is a lower bound for ranks with start/end probes. Matched time deltas are exploratory and include natural changes in batch shape.
